change.type: Material appearance correction on existing roof-zone top faces
details: Applied a pale neutral appearance to top faces in the existing 14–18m and 20–22m coarse LiDAR zones, reflecting their color family in the registered 2023 orthophoto.
Retained the Mayflower red appearance on the existing 18–20m band where the orthophoto shows an elongated red perimeter feature.
change.uncertainty: The colors describe the 2023 aerial appearance only; actual roof membrane, metal, concrete, and panel substrates are not inferred. The 5-ft LiDAR height bands do not trace exact architectural edges.
